name: Qingtian Kafeiguan
source: In the rainy season, the point when we met. It’s you, letting the dark clouds that around me dissipated and turn into sunny days. Therefore, this café is named after the sunny days that you like. It is called "Sunny Café”.
translation: 雨季，我们相遇的时刻。是你，让我身边的乌云消散，变成晴天。因此，这家咖啡馆就以你喜欢的阳光明媚的日子来命名。它的名字叫“阳光咖啡馆”。
